hero.title: Who Decides the Cord?
hero.subtitle: One evidence-based routine for the umbilical stump - plus the exact words to protect it from harmful 'remedies' without family war
hero.one_line_promise: A clear daily cord-care routine and red-flag triage your whole household follows, so everyone follows one rule and you know exactly when to see a doctor.

short_description: A clear daily cord-care routine and red-flag triage your whole household follows, so everyone follows one rule and you know exactly when to see a doctor.
trust_line: Educational content - not medical, clinical, or mental-health advice. Never diagnoses or treats. Any suspected infection goes to professional care the same day.
evidence_label: Educational content informed by sourced research and clinical guidance. It is not a substitute for medical, clinical, or mental-health assessment.

situation_block.label: Your situation
situation_block.body: The baby's umbilical stump is still attached and must be kept clean and dry while relatives insist on traditional substances (toothpaste, shea butter, herbs, hot compresses) and hospital discharge instructions said something different. She does not know which daily care routine is actually safe, which traditional practices are harmless versus dangerous, and which changes in the stump's appearance mean 'normal healing' versus 'infection needing a doctor tonight'.
